scope.method: Author semantic comparison of full current prompts, options, keys, stimuli and mapped distractor logic, plus immutable-text deltas against those current records and complete distinct guide texts. Automated inventory/pair enumeration is bookkeeping, not a semantic detector.
scope.outsideFreshFullCurrentScope: Chapter I S01–S03 current records retained in full corpus but not claimed as freshly read in full; their distinct historical text changes and all guides were included. Mapping inventory shows these outcomes are physical-world categories rather than candidate procedures.
scope.emptySkill: PHY7-U02-S01 has zero items and is not an extra assessment skill.
scope.history: All 290 immutable snapshots retained; 56 distinct historical prompt/options/key/stimulus texts relative to current content reviewed through full differing fields. Dedup excludes authoring metadata/mapping-note changes, which remain in full raw snapshots.
scope.guides: All 76 current plus 474 guide-history records retained; 138 distinct normalized full title/hint/strategy/worked-example texts read. No new learner guide is created.
scope.equivalentMappings: All 20 skill-outcome rows and curriculum reconciliation/mapping tables retained. S02/S03 share a Chapter II outcome and both complete banks are included. Chapter I S04–S10 cover experiment design, measurement and unit prerequisites and were read in full.
scope.source: Original Physics 7 Melikyan/Mailyan 2023 PDF hash verified; Chapter II §§7–13, printed pp24–41, and measurement/experiment prerequisites referenced per candidate. Figures22–32 inspected, but no candidate relies on an omitted image.
scope.protectedScope: No inaccessible protected bank in the selected scope. Archived S07-M05 and approved S05-M05 v2 are explicitly compared and preserved. No pool/form/model binding or release change is authorized.
scope.priorOmissions: All eleven B13 omitted leads reconsidered by full scenario/options/solution where related. No exact-pressure, stochastic-probability or heat-capacity procedure is reinstated. No omitted record is restored. New S03 grouping, S04 retained-film-volume and S07 bridge-design proposals explicitly repeat taught procedures under this new bounded manifest, with changed information structures and zero independent coverage.
